page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The host utilizes an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Hardware resources comprise 32 physical cores mapped across 64 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading enabled, supplemented by 256 GB of system RAM at a ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs delivering an aggregate 128 GB of VRAM. The instance includes 20 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth and does not feature local storage, requiring network-attached storage solutions.

Benchmark results highlight an architecture oriented toward parallelization over single-thread performance. The single-core stress-ng benchmark registered 1107.8 points, ranking in the lower 25 percent, while multi-core stress-ng performance reached an average category score of 47157.74 points. Single-threaded compression tasks underperformed, evidenced by gzip compression at 19.13 GB/sec and single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 7.58 GB/sec. When parallel scaling is engaged, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression placed in the top 25 percent at 200.07 GB/sec. Memory read operations yielded 121.44 GB/sec for uncached blocks, alongside Redis SET throughput of 41.84 million operations per second and static web throughput of 24.7 GB/sec.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the instance trades single-core throughput for dense GPU acceleration and massive multi-threaded parallel execution. Systems that do not require local ephemeral NVMe disks can leverage its eight-GPU topology efficiently for parallel computational loads. The ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge instance fits distributed deep learning training, batch neural network inference, scientific simulations, high-performance computing pipelines, and multi-stream parallel media rendering.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c8g1.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for massively parallel computing tasks. Built on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 platform running at 2.5 GHz, the configuration supplies 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores, 256 GB of system RAM, and eight NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs totaling 128 GB of VRAM. Network baseline capacity reaches 20 Gbps, and no local disk storage is included. Benchmarks show modest single-thread metrics, including lower-quartile stress-ng single-core and compression marks, contrasting with strong multi-threaded execution such as 200.07 GB/sec in parallel bzip3 decompression. The system provides balanced memory bandwidth and Redis SET performance at 41.84 million operations per second. This instance is best aligned with multi-GPU deep learning training, parallel scientific workloads, and distributed batch processing.
